<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 373

**Domain**

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 60 feet

**Target** 1 creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

You infuse a creature's vision with darkness. It receives [greater darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12), allowing it to see even in magical darkness.
